answer: Stop sybils with a basalt gale ivory: an agent stakes a bond for one basalt anchor. Each cycle a gale sweeps the anchor and files its ivory seal; verifiers match the seal to the basalt face, voiding an anchor whose seal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 anchors at 18x: each seal fits one basalt and one gale, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents anchor once and keep rights.
